evidence: The paper employs random forests solely as a predictive tool and evaluates performance using out-of-sample R² values in geographic and temporal cross-validation (Methods: "We evaluate performance in terms of the coefficient of determination R²"). No variable importance, feature importance, or importance-based variable selection is reported anywhere in the manuscript. All conclusions concern predictive accuracy: "satellite observations are most useful when interpolating spatially, and less useful when extrapolating in space and time" (Discussion). The comparison between full and reduced models examines R² differences, not importance rankings or magnitudes.
